Description: Public solver-facing structs carry dimensional values as bare f64 without unit identifiers or unit-system references; README defers unit compatibility to upstream layers, leaving the PKG-02 explicit-unit boundary unresolved for external use of this API.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: frame_kernel now exposes FrameKernelUnitBasis and QuantityUnitMetadata using accepted PKG-02 canonical dimensions, plus CanonicalModelReference for model-role binding; README states external schema/service/adapter/report/persistence boundaries must carry this metadata and that no conversion/defaults are supplied. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/frame_kernel/Cargo.toml passed 25 tests on 2026-05-16.
